name: Baby Mothers
overview: Scripture reveals that motherhood is both a profound blessing and a source of sorrow, as God declared in Genesis 3:16 that a woman will bring forth children in sorrow. Yet, the Lord also graciously grants the joy of motherhood, as seen in Psalms 113:9 where He transforms barrenness into the joyful role of raising children. Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), and a godly mother is honored by her children and husband (Proverbs 31:28). The faithfulness of God in fulfilling His promises to mothers is exemplified in His visitation to Sarah (Genesis 21:1), affirming His sovereign hand in the gift of children.
